#!/bin/bash
set -o nounset    # error when referencing undefined variable
set -o errexit    # exit when command fails
shopt -s extglob
shopt -s nullglob
#
PRIORITY=6
#
#
# Определение переменных
SOURCE="Pererozhdenie_v_aristokrata_so_sposobnostyu_analiza_s02e01_PRT261022131634_id63506.mp4"
SRT=""
HSUBFILE=""
BASENAME=""
NAME_TAG=""
SEASON_DIR=""
OUTBASE="${BASENAME}${NAME_TAG}"
YADIF=""
HSUB=""
#
# Генерирование вторичных переменных
# Важно - этот пути которые должны быть понятны машине, которая исполняет скрипт, а не пишет его!!
TARGET_DIR="/mnt/pemaltynov/ROOT/EDIT/_amedia/${BASENAME}${SEASON_DIR}"
BUFFER="/home/pemaltynov/IN/"
IN_PROGRESS="/home/pemaltynov/IN/_IN_PROGRESS"
DONE="/home/pemaltynov/IN/_DONE"
NOTIFICATIONS="/home/pemaltynov/IN/notifications"
READY_FILE="${OUTBASE}.ready"

#
# Создаем пути
mkdir -p ${TARGET_DIR}
mv "${BUFFER}/${SOURCE}" "${IN_PROGRESS}/${SOURCE}"



# Сборка команды

ffmpeg -n -r 25 -i "${IN_PROGRESS}/${SOURCE}" \
  -filter_complex "[0:v:0]${HSUB}${YADIF}setsar=(1/1)[vidHD];[0:1]aresample=48000,atempo=25/(25/1)[aud0]" \
  -map "[vidHD]" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile high -g 0 -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 "${TARGET_DIR}/Pererozhdenie_v_aristokrata_so_sposobnostyu_analiza_s02/Pererozhdenie_v_aristokrata_so_sposobnostyu_analiza_s02_01_HD.mp4" \
  -map "[aud0]" -c:a alac -compression_level 0 -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 "${TARGET_DIR}/Pererozhdenie_v_aristokrata_so_sposobnostyu_analiza_s02/Pererozhdenie_v_aristokrata_so_sposobnostyu_analiza_s02_01_HD_AUDIO00_RUS20.m4a"

mv "${IN_PROGRESS}/${SOURCE}" "${DONE}/${SOURCE}"


touch "${TARGET_DIR}/${READY_FILE}"
cp ${TARGET_DIR}/${READY_FILE} ${NOTIFICATIONS}/${READY_FILE}
mv "$0" "${DONE}/bash/"
